messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey all — first week question: where are the dev infra runbooks in Notion? I can only find product handbooks and a bunch of view-only pages. Also I can't edit or duplicate the templates I need. Who should I ping for access?
Sam DevEx: welcome Aisha! Dev infra runbooks live under the Eng Infra space: https://redwood.notion.site/eng-infra-runbooks — if you can only view, it's likely you weren't added to the Docs Editors group. @Jules People Ops handles group adds.
Aisha Patel: thanks — I searched for 'runbooks' but didn't see that page. If I duplicate a team template to my workspace, does it keep permissions? worried about breaking the canonical one.
Marco Eng: Duplicate which menu -> "Duplicate to workspace". That makes a copy in your personal workspace and it won't affect the canonical page. Some pages have block-level locks so duplicate may be disabled — in that case ping the page owner to unlock.
Sam DevEx: quick checklist: 1) confirm SSO email is same as your account; 2) check you got the "Docs Editors" group; 3) try duplicating. If duplicate is disabled, tell us the page link and we'll temporarily enable duplication. We also have a Templates library: https://redwood.notion.site/devex-templates
Aisha Patel: I don't see the "Docs Editors" group in my profile. Jules, can you add me? my SSO email is aisha@redwood.ai
Jules People Ops: added you to Docs Editors just now — you should get an email invite. If Notion was open during the change, sign out and sign in again with SSO.
notion-invite-bot: Sent invite to aisha@redwood.ai for group "Docs Editors" — status: pending acceptance.
Aisha Patel: got the invite email and accepted. I can duplicate templates now. A few extra Qs: where's the onboarding checklist template? and is there a preferred template for team runbooks + incident logs?
Sam DevEx: onboarding checklists live in People Ops: https://redwood.notion.site/people-ops/onboarding/checklists — copy the "New Hire 1W checklist" template. For runbook+incident templates, use the "Runbook + Incident Log" template in the DevEx template library. If your team needs a custom variant, we can add it to the library.
Aisha Patel: how do I request a custom template? we want a runbook that includes prefilled run commands + a tiny playbook.
Sam DevEx: two options: 1) open a PR in the docs-templates repo with the Notion page link and desired changes (we'll sync it); or 2) DM me the structure and I'll onboard it. If you want it visible to the whole org, we'll vet and add to the template library.
Aisha Patel: awesome, I'll DM you the layout. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: — super helpful!
Sam DevEx: welcome again — ping #devex if anything else breaks or if you want a quick walkthrough.
Marco Eng: one more tip — if you plan to maintain the runbook, add an "Owner" property and a weekly review reminder. helps keep things current.
Aisha Patel: noted. Appreciate the help!
